regenerationJustification.cite: coordinator dispatch on hub #29102 (2026-09-07, relayed as owner-directed; no named human in the dispatch record) settled WHAT ships — configOptions from model/list at session acquisition (spec 211 T041); the wire-level choices are recorded in spec 211 spec.md Clarifications (Session 2026-09-07, T041 catalog at acquisition), with the catalog-cost arm settled as Arm A by the 2026-09-08 owner ruling (mjdouglas; ADR docs/adr/18954-t041-catalog-at-acquisition.md; Constitution IV record on #18954 and PR #30991); prior content ruling preserved: owner ruling on mslsrc/tbh#22946 review comment r3863946961 (2026-08-26, live session, "approve required-nullable"); tdd SS2.4 and the SS2.5.1 Session example
regenerationJustification.rationale: T041 moves catalog discovery to session acquisition: the adapter sends one model/list inside the session/new window (after session/start's result, sessionful) or, on session/load, a SESSIONLESS model/list BEFORE session/resume (SS3.10 allows listing before a session exists; the durable selection comes from the lifecycle result's own modelId). The host's SS2.5.2 re-issue order is untouched: pending asks still land right after the resume result, and the CLIENT (bridge) awaits their receipts before its first view/page. The inserted catalog is hand-authored COHERENT with the recorded session (provider muse, modelId muse-large-2; isActive only on sessionful lists, per SS3.10) rather than a copy of another host's capture. Beyond the inserted exchange, no frame, order, or value changes.
